ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The two figures in the attachment show the same large triangle, divided by internal line segments into 7 small triangles. method.method_draft: Read the diagram as seven small triangles labeled 10, 11, 15, 12, 9, 13, and 20. Use a signed cancellation sum based on shared edges: add the perimeter labels of triangles 10, 11, 9, 12, and 20, and subtract the labels of triangles 15 and 13. The shared internal edges cancel because each such edge appears once with a plus sign and once with a minus sign, while every side segment on the outside boundary of the large triangle remains once with a plus sign. Thus the large triangle perimeter is 10 + 11 + 9 + 12 + 20 - 15 - 13 = 34.
